title: Velocity at highest point
description: Essential: Correctly states or derives the condition for circular motion at point F, leading to v_F = sqrt(g r) = 1 m/s.

title: Normal force at E
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the normal force at point E using Newton's second law for circular motion, yielding F_N ≈ 0.14 N.

title: Spring energy for given h
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the initial spring potential energy E_p0 using energy conservation including friction on OE, yielding 0.008 J.

title: Energy relation derivation
description: Important: Derives the general relationship E_p = mg h + μ mg (L1 + L2) using energy conservation from launch to point B.

title: Height range condition
description: Important: Identifies the valid range for h (0.05 m ≤ h ≤ 0.2 m) from the conditions of clearing point F and geometry of AB.

title: Work-energy on incline
description: Important: Applies the work-energy theorem correctly on the inclined track AB, accounting for gravity and friction.

title: Circular motion condition
description: Important: Recognizes that for successful passage, the normal force at F must be ≥ 0, leading to the minimum speed condition.

title: Sign error in work-energy
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns signs to the work done by gravity or friction on the inclined track AB.

title: Unit conversion mistake
description: Pitfall: Fails to convert mass from grams to kilograms consistently, leading to incorrect numerical answers.

title: Forgetting friction on OE
description: Pitfall: Omits the work done by friction on the horizontal segment OE in the energy conservation equations.
